name: Sproutcycled Glass Germinator | The Complete Sprouting Kit | 500 ml
shortStory: Grow fresh. Waste less. The Sproutcycled Glass Germinator transforms reclaimed glass into a functional kitchen essential, making it easy to grow fresh sprouts at home. Designed for sprouting a variety of beans, legumes and seeds, this thoughtfully crafted kit helps you incorporate homegrown goodness into your everyday meals.

sections.title: Product Features
sections.content:
• Material: Upcycled wine bottle glass and PLA bioplastic components
• Capacity: 500 ml
• Components: Glass tumbler, bioplastic lid stand and bioplastic grid
• Usage: Home sprouting of beans, legumes and seeds
• Reusable: Designed for repeated use
• Design: Angled drainage system to support airflow and help prevent waterlogging
• Net Weight: 415 g
• Dimensions: 9.5 × 9.5 × 22 cm
• Shipping: Dispatched within 2–3 working days

sections.title: Care Instructions
sections.content:
• Upcycled Glass Tumbler: Dishwasher safe with a gentle detergent. Handle with care.
• Bioplastic Lid & Grid: Handwash using mild dishwashing liquid and a soft scrubber. Store in a cool, dry place, away from direct heat and high temperatures.
• Drying: Allow all components to air-dry completely before storing.
• Avoid: Harsh chemicals, abrasive scrubbers and excessive heat to maintain the quality and durability of the components.
• Handcrafted Uniqueness: Each tumbler is handcrafted from reclaimed glass bottles, so slight variations in shape, colour and finish are natural and add to its uniqueness. The shade of green may vary depending on bottle availability.
